description: Turn click-to-pin comments on or off for a page. While on, anyone who can view the page can click a spot on it to comment once they sign in with their email (on a work-email-locked page, their viewing sign-in is enough); the maker gets an email per comment. Off hides comments without deleting them. Off by default. Returns { ok, page_id, commentsEnabled }. Use it when the human asks for feedback or review on a page.

enabled.description: true turns comments on, false turns them off.

page_id.description: The page id: the `id` field from publish_page or list_pages (also the last path segment of the page URL, …/docs/<page_id>). Only pages in the connected maker's space are visible.

name: set_comments
title: Turn comments on or off for a page
